ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white florets, clustered and slightly irregular, matte surface with small bumpy textures, piece sizes about 2-4 cm, soft-firm and holding shape, sitting on the left-upper side of the plate and covering roughly 25% of the plate area | 150
ITEM 2 | Golden-orange roasted vegetable wedge with browned, slightly caramelized edges and dark char spots, sheen from oil, about 6 cm long and 3 cm thick, sitting at the lower center-right and partly covered by crumbs | 70
ITEM 3 | Sliced pale pinkish-white meat with a light golden crust, moist and juicy looking, slices about 6 cm long and 2 cm thick, sitting in the center-right of the plate on top of crumbs | 90
ITEM 4 | Dark brown roasted meat pieces with crisp browned edges and some darker glazed bits, irregular chunks about 3-4 cm, slightly glossy, sitting at the lower right of the plate next to the orange wedge | 80
ITEM 5 | Orange-red roasted vegetable piece with a crumbly golden crust and green flecks, about 5 cm across, sitting at the upper right beside the white meat | 45
ITEM 6 | Golden-brown coarse crumb coating or breadcrumb-like topping scattered across the meat and vegetables, dry and granular, small loose particles spread around the lower center and right edges | 15
